# Final Implementation Plan

## Wave A — Close current proof
- Harvest the freshest release-suite result.
- Fix only current-tree failures, using full-file rewrites.
- Regenerate derived catalog and sitemap as needed.

## Wave B — Runtime proof
- Restore production-faithful validator if required.
- Launch fresh Chrome at 390x844.
- Verify foundation injection, `commerce-004`, launcher, sheet, Radiance anonymous state, console, and responsive behavior.

## Wave C — Startup evidence
- Launch isolated full server with temporary database/background workers disabled only where already supported.
- Capture stage timings for log key, database initialization, task runner, and auth.
- Identify the real pre-bind bottleneck from measured output.

## Wave D — Parallel discovery
- Audit recents/favorites/resume.
- Audit workflow handoff/share/export/import.
- Audit wallet reconciliation/observability.
- Audit global accessibility/performance.
- Audit weak marketing/product-copy surfaces.
- Audit game monetization opportunities.
- Audit creator/developer premium-value opportunities.

## Wave E — Implement next high-value shared capability
- Prefer one platform-level primitive with broad leverage over dozens of duplicated app edits.
- Write small focused modules, exhaustive JSDoc, tabs, exact headers, <120 lines.
- Test behavior, reread touched files, and compare planned vs actual.
